shortDescription: Explore Galle Fort, beaches, and southern coastal heritage in one private day.
overview:
A private day along Sri Lanka's south coast to UNESCO-listed Galle Dutch Fort. Walk the ramparts, explore colonial streets, boutiques, and cafés, and take in sweeping ocean views from one of Asia's best-preserved forts.
Optional coastal stops can include stilt fishermen viewpoints and nearby beaches before your comfortable return transfer — paced for culture, photos, and a relaxed southern atmosphere.
